system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Comprehensive spatial dataset of sub-national administrative units for all countries in the world, consistent with UN delineation of international boundaries. Available at three hierarchical levels: Level 0 (countries), Level 1 (provinces/states), and Level 2 (districts/counties).

data_description.temporal_coverage: 2024 version represents the current administrative boundary configuration; maintained and updated regularly by FAO.
data_description.spatial_resolution: Administrative boundary polygons at national, provincial, and district levels
data_description.records: Global administrative units at three hierarchical levels with attributes including administrative names, codes, and hierarchical relationships.
data_description.data_type_numeric: Administrative codes, area calculations, and hierarchical identifiers.
data_description.important_note: GAUL is the authoritative global administrative boundary dataset maintained by FAO. Three separate assets are available for different administrative levels (L0, L1, L2). The dataset is crucial for spatial aggregation, administrative reporting, and regional analysis. It follows UN standards for international boundaries.

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Administrative boundary polygons with administrative names, codes, and hierarchical attributes.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use appropriate level (L0, L1, or L2) based on analysis scale. Inspect property names for administrative codes and names for spatial joins and aggregations.

data_description.data_source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
